title: Alexis King -  “Effects for Less” @ ZuriHac 2020
summary: Alexis King's ZuriHac 2020 talk on how effect systems in Haskell can be implemented efficiently. It looks at the performance cost of effect libraries and how to reduce it.
why: HN commenters call it among the best talks of 2020 for understanding Haskell effect systems.

quote.text: the best one I did watch this year was Alexis King's 'Effects for Less' (Haskell).
